newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Submissions on NZ CPI close June 19 - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: Submissions on NZ CPI close June 19 - SNZ.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand said on Friday that discussion papers for the Consumers Price Index were now available and that submissions on the CPI's revision would close on June 19.
The 12 papers range in subject from what the CPI should measure and the methodology behind the CPI as to how prices should be obtained.
The CPI revision advisory committee will meet on May 20 and 22, with a follow-up meeting in mid-July, when public submissions will be considered.
